## 1. Strategy Logic

At each closed H4 bar, the EA ranks the host pair's 60-bar return against the
same return for the seven registered USD majors. It buys the top-ranked tail
at or above the 85th percentile and sells the bottom-ranked tail at or below
the 15th percentile, with a two-ATR protective stop and no fixed profit target.
Each symbol can enter at most once per calendar week; an open position closes
at the next framework-derived weekly boundary for deterministic rebalancing.

Entry/exit logic is encoded in the five `Strategy_*` hooks in
`QM5_37007_cross-sectional-momentum-factor-dispersion.mq5`. Framework wiring (risk, magic, news, Friday close)
is inherited from `QM_Common.mqh` and is not redocumented here.
